{{Quote|We could still be back in time for the wedding, couldn't we?|Ken to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="POB" />}}
The '''wedding''' of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was to take place on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. The ceremony was in the [[Grand Audience Chamber]] of the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], where the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had once [[Royal Award Ceremony/Legends|celebrated]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|explosion]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] Imperial [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], although the Chamber's central aisle had been refitted with a red carpet for the occasion. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] was to serve as Solo's best man, while the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] counterparts [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were to share the title of "best droid."<ref name="POB" /> However, the ceremony was aborted before the bride could even walk down the aisle when [[Triclops]], son of the late [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], entered the room and attacked the attendants. That incident set the [[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa/Legends|actual wedding]] back<ref name="SPINblog" /> for [[8 ABY/Legends|three more years]].<ref name="COPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>
